title: Etale residue triple unit refinement
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $p$ a prime, $K$ a field, and $\chi:\kappa(p)\to K$ a field homomorphism. For a triple $t=(B,\alpha,q,\phi)$ in [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples] and $f\in B\setminus q$, there are a triple $s=(B_s,\alpha_s,q_s,\phi_s)$ and a morphism $a:t\to s$ whose underlying ring map sends $f$ to a unit of $B_s$.

proof.text: Write beta:B -> K for the residue map of t. The residue-field identification identifies this composite with B -> kappa(q) -> K. The first map has kernel q by the definition of the residue field, and the subsequent field maps are injective; hence beta(x)=0 exactly when x belongs to q. The existing proved helper triple_map_eq_zero implements this calculation and is reused from the simple-roots construction module. Thus beta(f) is nonzero and a unit in K. Define L = Localization.Away f and gamma:L -> K by IsLocalization.Away.lift; lift_eq proves that gamma extends beta.

Construct q_s as the prime kernel of gamma. Elements outside q_s have nonzero, hence invertible, image in K, so Ideal.ResidueField.lift supplies the residue-field map, transported to the scheme residue field by Spec.residueFieldIso. Its composite with evaluation equals gamma by lift_algebraMap. The identity gamma(algebraMap b) = beta(b) shows that q_s pulls back to q, so lies over p, and gives compatibility with chi. Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway f and HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff show that Spec(L) -> Spec(B) is etale; clause (2) of lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation composes this with the given etale map to Spec(R). Construct the triple s with ring L and the morphism t -> s using Under.homMk and Over.homMk. The ring diagram sends it to the localization map, whose value on f is a unit by IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit.

proof_origin: Stacks Project Tags 04GN and 04GP, principal-localization refinement in the henselization proof, with kernel and residue-field constructions. Lean proof by A3, 2026-10-12; principal-localization etaleness is supplied directly by Mathlib (Stacks Tag 00U2(1)), and composition by the existing Mathlib leaf. Repair by A3: reuse the existing triple_map_eq_zero helper, exposed in its original module; no duplicate kernel theorem is declared.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleResidueTriple_unit_refinement
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (χ : (Spec R).residueField p ⟶ CommRingCat.of K)
    (t : EtaleResidueTriples R p K χ) (f : t.B) (hf : f ∉ t.q.asIdeal) :
    ∃ (s : EtaleResidueTriples R p K χ) (a : t ⟶ s),
      IsUnit (((etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K χ).map a).hom f)
